I hope you're doing great! I'm a young 3D artist from Pakistan and a big fan of your amazing animal models on Sketchfab. I had two questions that I’ve been struggling to solve for a long time. First, how do you create such clean and realistic bird feathers, like on your this model? Whenever I try using Blender’s particle system and convert the hair to mesh, the topology becomes very messy and heavy — so I’m curious if you use some special method or add-on for that. Second, in your family packs (like birds or animals with multiple characters), I noticed that multiple rigs are animated at the same time in Sketchfab’s 3D viewer. When I try it, only one rig plays animation while others stay still — so how do you manage to make all rigs play their animations at once? I would be really grateful if you could share a little guidance on this, it would mean a lot to me!
